🖼️ Fam, meet @yeko_yekill exploding into our Art Division this September 19th at @seaseaclub.bcn .
His art rises with force, speaks with intention and commands the wall with pure impact! 💥

@yeko_yekill started painting walls in 2008, shaped by the graffiti culture of Valencia and Orihuela. Sketchbooks became his universe, each page sharpening a style that later evolved through his studies in Design and Creative Technologies and a Master’s in Digital Illustration and Concept Art. Murals became his full time mission, taking him to major institutions, international projects and top graffiti festivals across Europe like Roskilde, Southend City Jam and Step In The Arena.

His world blends fantasy, mythology, medieval and gothic atmospheres, sci‑fi futurism and wildstyle lettering, all fused into powerful visual storytelling that hits you instantly.

🌅 On September 19th, his universe rises with the sunset, entering the Golden Hour Ceremony for the very first time.
